entities.summary: Margrave (Prince) Charles Gustav of Baden-Durlach was a German general. He was the son of Margrave Frederick VI of Baden-Durlach and his wife Christina Magdalena of the Palatinate-Zweibrücken, sister of King Charles X Gustav of Sweden.
